notes: REF-BM-02: capture() collects title/description/preview image (og:image) but never a favicon. REF-BM-03: save is immediate on URL entry with no pre-save draft/preview, so auto-collected title/description can only be edited after saving, not before. REF-BM-07: cards show title/description/tags/preview image but no favicon (only a text site name). REF-BM-08: clicking a list item opens a details modal; the original URL is reachable only via an 'Open original link' inside that modal, not by selecting the item itself. REF-BM-12: search haystack (searchable/textOf) covers title, description, note, site name and page text but not the bookmark's url. REF-BM-17: read-later can only be set via a checkbox at save time; there is no control to mark an existing finished bookmark back to unread. REF-BM-20: multi-select bulk actions implement only add-label and archive; remove-tags, read/unread and bulk delete are missing. REF-BM-21: only 'Select all shown' exists, which is capped to the current page (pageSize slice); there is no affordance to apply an action to the entire filtered collection across pages. REF-BM-23: notes use a contenteditable rich-text/HTML editor (execCommand bold/list) rendered as stored HTML, not markdown input/parsing. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive / Wayback snapshot integration anywhere in the code.
